narr: A moist airmass was in place across the lower Mid Atlantic and Southeast with dew points in the upper 60s to lower 70s. A weak surface low moved across the area from western Virginia to southeastern Virginia during the afternoon of May 6. This surface low allowed for widespread convection across the state with widespread moderate rainfall and locally heavy rainfall. In addition to the rain, isolated severe storms with gusty winds also occurred.
ev: VDOT reported high water on Courthouse Road (VA-201) with partial road closures in numerous locations due to heavy rainfall.
Flooding due to heavy rain was reported by the public near the intersection of Armistead Avenue and Mercer Avenue.
The right lane and right shoulder of I-95 north were closed due to high water from heavy rain.
VDOT cameras showed at least six inches of water covering the roadway at the corner of Belvidere Street and Canal Street.
The 911 call center reported high water due to heavy rain near the intersection of Countyline Church Road (US-603) and Ladysmith Road (US-639).
The 911 call center reported flooded roads in Port Royal due to heavy rain.
